mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agreed_json,'$.pricing_version')) AS pricing_version FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET insured=#{choice},insurance_premium=#{premium},declared_value=#{declaredValue},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status IN('requesting','negotiating','vendor_deposit_pending')
